objective: Review the FIT5032 Week 3 and Week 4 Library application against the assignment requirements, focusing on Bootstrap responsiveness, form validation, PrimeVue DataTable, evidence completeness, and accessibility.

evidence.content:
Students must demonstrate Bootstrap 5 responsive layout using breakpoint classes such as col-12 col-md-6.
Students must include evidence for the required CSS styling activities.
Students must include minlength maxlength attributes.
Students must implement Australian Resident validation.
Students must demonstrate the submitted user information in a PrimeVue DataTable.
Students must include evidence of the GitHub commit history.

Criterion,Requirement,Evidence expectation
Responsive layout,Students must use Bootstrap breakpoint classes such as col-12 col-md-6,Show mobile and tablet layouts
CSS activities,Students must include evidence for tag class ID and attribute selectors,Show CSS code and rendered result
HTML validation,Students must include required minlength and maxlength validation,Show source code and browser validation feedback
Vue validation,Students must implement Australian Resident validation,Show validation logic and front-end feedback
DataTable,Students must demonstrate submitted records in a PrimeVue DataTable,Show the rendered table
GitHub,Students must include GitHub commit history evidence,Show the commit history page

Students must provide multiple screenshots for separate activities.
Students must show the original HTML validation before replacing it with custom Vue validation.
Students must show extra validation cases for username and password.
Students must validate Australian Resident, Gender, and Reason for joining.
Students must show the GitHub commit history rather than a single commit diff.
Students must ensure that screenshots are readable and not cropped.

The form uses Bootstrap classes col-12 col-md-6 for responsive layout.
The username input validates a minimum length of 3 characters and allows only letters numbers and underscores.
The password validates a minimum length of 8 characters and checks uppercase lowercase number and special character rules.
The gender field is validated with validateGender.
The reason field is validated with validateReason and requires at least 10 characters.
The form uses required attributes and novalidate.
Australian Resident validation is not implemented.
The errors object contains username password gender and reason but does not contain Australian Resident.
The submitted information is displayed using a PrimeVue DataTable.
Passwords are masked with bullet characters.
The DataTable currently supports submitted records but the evidence shows only one submitted record.
The implementation does not contain the Week 3 pure CSS selector evidence.
The implementation does not contain minlength maxlength attributes.
The available GitHub screenshot shows a single commit diff rather than the GitHub commit history.
